overview.description: The Northern Trust Morningstar Global Upstream Natural Resources ETF (GUNR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund tracks an index of global companies that operate, manage or produce natural resources in energy, agriculture, metals, timber or water. GUNR was launched on Sep 16, 2011 and is issued by Northern Trust.
